reason: Content was collected verbatim from https://www.standupmitra.in/Home/SUISchemes on 2026-10-11, but standupmitra.in is a bare .in domain and the provenance gate refuses any record citing a non-government domain as authoritative. The quoted material is kept here so the collection is not lost; it must not enter the processed dataset until the same figures are confirmed against a .gov.in or .nic.in source.
toPromote: Find the scheme on financialservices.gov.in or the governing circular.
Confirm the composite loan range of 10 lakh to 100 lakh.
Confirm the green-field-only condition and the 51% shareholding condition.
Set officialSourceUrl and sourceDomain to the .gov.in source, set lastVerifiedAt, then move into processed.

candidate.targetBusinessTypesNote: The page does not enumerate legal forms. It distinguishes individual from non-individual enterprises and imposes a shareholding condition on the latter, which is captured in eligibilityCriteria rather than as a legal-form restriction.
candidate.supportedIndustriesNote: Quoted sectors are 'manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or the trading sector'. These are broad activity classes rather than the industry vocabulary used for matching, so no industry restriction is recorded in order to avoid a false mismatch.
candidate.supportedStagesNote: DERIVED from the quoted requirement that loans are 'available for only green field project', which the page defines as 'the first time venture of the beneficiary'. The source uses no stage labels, so this mapping is derived, not quoted.
candidate.supportedLocationsNote: A central scheme; no state restriction is stated on the page.
candidate.supportedFundingTypesNote: Quoted: 'Composite loan (inclusive of term loan and working capital) between 10 lakh and upto 100 lakh.'
supportedPurposes: Setting up a new enterprise in manufacturing

candidate.fundingAmountDescription: Quoted: 'Composite loan (inclusive of term loan and working capital) between 10 lakh and upto 100 lakh.' The page further states the composite loan covers '85% of the project cost', and that 'the borrower shall be required to bring in minimum of 10% of the project cost as own contribution'.
candidate.totalOutlayNote: Not stated on the collected page.
eligibilityCriteria: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneurs, above 18 years of age.

Loans under the scheme is available for only green field project. Green field signifies, in this context, the first time venture of the beneficiary in the manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or the trading sector.
In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either SC/ST and/or Women Entrepreneur.
candidate.eligibilityRulesNote: The SC/ST and gender conditions are categorical facts about the applicant that this platform does not collect, so they are deliberately left as stated criteria for the user to read rather than as machine-checkable rules. Encoding them as rules would require the platform to hold caste data, which it does not and should not.
candidate.documentRequirementsNote: Not enumerated on the collected page.
candidate.applicationProcess: Quoted details from the page: the loan 'is repayable in 7 years with a maximum moratorium period of 18 months'; the scheme 'envisages 15% margin money which can be provided in convergence with eligible Central / State schemes'; and besides primary security the loan 'may be secured by collateral security or guarantee of Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Stand-Up India Loans (CGFSIL) as decided by the banks'.
candidate.sourceDateNote: The page carries no publication or last-updated date.
candidate.verificationNote: Collected from the official Stand-Up Mitra portal on 2026-10-11 and quoted verbatim. Held at NEEDS_VERIFICATION rather than VERIFIED for one specific reason: standupmitra.in is a bare .in domain and is therefore not on this project's allowlist of authoritative suffixes (.gov.in, .nic.in, .org.in). The portal is operated by SIDBI and is the scheme's official application site, but until the same figures are confirmed against a .gov.in source this record must not be published or matched against.
candidate.schemeStatusNote: The page presents the scheme as currently operating.
